request: Which country has the most time zones? A quick quiz as a two-voice dialogue. #interactive #short
subtitle: Russia? The USA? Guess which country runs the most clocks, then hear why the answer is France, and why vast China gets by with just one.

spec.title: Which country has the most time zones?

sources.title: Which country has the most time zones?
sources.finding: France uses 12 time zones (13 with its Antarctic claim), Russia and the USA 11 each; China uses one

card.title: Which country has the most time zones?

commands.speak: Which country on Earth has the most time zones?
Easy. Russia. It's the biggest country there is.

quiz.question: Which country has the most time zones?
quiz.right: France, with twelve, thanks to islands and territories scattered around the globe.

commands.speak: Russia has eleven. The United States, counting its Pacific islands, also has eleven.
France? Mainland France would fit inside Texas!
The mainland has just one clock.
But Tahiti, Guadeloupe, Réunion and New Caledonia are France too, each on its own time.
And China? It's almost as wide as the United States.
One time zone. All of China runs on Beijing time.
So in the far west, a winter sunrise comes after ten in the morning.
So the sun never sets on France?
Just about. From Polynesia to the Indian Ocean, it is nearly always daytime somewhere in France.
